name: partitaiva24-pp-mcp
description: Every Partitaiva24 endpoint as a typed CLI command, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers the questions the web UI doesn't — turnover countdown, quarterly tax projection, AR aging, SDI status sweep.

p24_cookie.title: P24_COOKIE
p24_cookie.description: WordPress session cookie (p24_logged_in_<hash>) plus an X-WP-Nonce header. Capture both from your browser DevTools after signing in to partitaiva24.cloud, then run `auth set --cookie '<full-cookie>' --nonce '<nonce>'`. Nonces rotate roughly every 24 hours; refresh just the nonce when calls return rest_cookie_invalid_nonce.
